provenance.method: deterministic interpolation only; no new terrain facts

rizoma.settlement: all causal nodes read one prior snapshot; deltas merge once

laws.nonNegotiable: unknown physical detail stays unknown; visual decoder cannot invent entities

physicsConstants.scalePolicy: exact/conventional constants where defined; scale-appropriate numerical models must conserve tracked quantities

matter.rule: microscopic laws are retained conceptually; current scale tracks conserved macroscopic state

biomass.state: living organic matter; aggregate composition unresolved

visualDecoderContract.hardRule: appearance only; may not create/delete/relocate entities

terrain.authority: Mapzen / Linux Foundation via AWS Open Data
terrain.role: global bare-earth terrain heights; SRTM and other open DEM sources

landCover.method: one official raster export matched to colors decoded from the official ArcGIS legend

phase.rule: environment must remain causally self-sustaining before fauna or humans become active

questions: What changes when nobody is watching?

provenance.note: bulk density and active erosion depth are model parameters until site measurements exist; transfers remain internally conservative

gates.criteria: fauna gate requires >=12 consecutive viable landscape cycles with conservative water/sediment budgets, >=100 plants and viable mean soil moisture

climateContext.confidence: regional prior only; not a substitute for station observations
rules: do not force rain merely because the season is rainy
season context may modulate probabilities only after calibration against station data

physicalRules.energy: conserve tracked energy; solar forcing enters, storage/phase change/longwave/convection remove or redistribute it
physicalRules.water: conserve tracked water mass across precipitation, storage, infiltration, runoff, uptake and evaporation
physicalRules.sediment: erosion is a transfer between tracked soil/sediment reservoirs, not creation/destruction of mass
physicalRules.biology: germination and growth require local water/temperature/resource viability; death returns matter to detrital/soil pools

regionalNature.sourcePolicy: official Panama sources first; primary scientific sources for universal physics; unknown site-specific values stay unknown until observed or calibrated

imhpaRain.authority: Instituto de Meteorologia e Hidrologia de Panama (IMHPA)
imhpaRain.claim: Pacific rainy season broadly May-November; dry season December-April; veranillo often July-August; afternoon convection common in rainy season

miambienteSoils.claim: official soil, geomorphology, lithology and historical land-cover layers

miambienteHydro.claim: official hydrographic basin context where available

nasaEnergy.claim: solar forcing, reflection, absorption, evaporation, convection and longwave emission must respect energy conservation
